budget_versions_submitted_matches_status.name: budget_versions_submitted_matches_status
budget_versions_submitted_matches_status.value: ("budget_versions"."status" = 'draft') = ("budget_versions"."submitted_at" IS NULL) AND ("budget_versions"."submitted_at" IS NULL) = ("budget_versions"."submitted_by_user_id" IS NULL)

budget_versions_locked_matches_status.name: budget_versions_locked_matches_status
budget_versions_locked_matches_status.value: ("budget_versions"."status" = 'locked') = ("budget_versions"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("budget_versions"."locked_at" IS NULL) = ("budget_versions"."locked_by_user_id" IS NULL)

file_objects_status_matches_timestamps.name: file_objects_status_matches_timestamps
file_objects_status_matches_timestamps.value: ("file_objects"."status" = 'staged' AND "file_objects"."available_at" IS NULL AND "file_objects"."deleted_at" IS NULL) OR ("file_objects"."status" = 'available' AND "file_objects"."available_at" IS NOT NULL AND "file_objects"."deleted_at" IS NULL) OR ("file_objects"."status" = 'deleted' AND "file_objects"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)

finance_sources_approval_matches_status.name: finance_sources_approval_matches_status
finance_sources_approval_matches_status.value: ("finance_sources"."status" = 'approved') = ("finance_sources"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("finance_sources"."approved_at" IS NULL) = ("finance_sources"."approved_by_user_id" IS NULL)

project_reviews_scores_in_range.name: project_reviews_scores_in_range
project_reviews_scores_in_range.value: "project_reviews"."script_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND "project_reviews"."director_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND "project_reviews"."cast_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND "project_reviews"."financing_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 10

project_stage_history_created_shape.name: project_stage_history_created_shape
project_stage_history_created_shape.value: (("project_stage_history"."transition_type" = 'created' AND "project_stage_history"."from_stage" IS NULL) OR ("project_stage_history"."transition_type" <> 'created' AND "project_stage_history"."from_stage" IS NOT NULL))

project_tasks_completed_at_matches_statu.name: project_tasks_completed_at_matches_status
project_tasks_completed_at_matches_statu.value: ("project_tasks"."status" = 'done' AND "project_tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("project_tasks"."status" = 'open' AND "project_tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)

projects_archive_fields_coherent.name: projects_archive_fields_coherent
projects_archive_fields_coherent.value:
(
        ("projects"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "projects"."archive_reason" IS NULL AND "projects"."archive_revisit" IS NULL AND "projects"."archive_starred" IS NULL AND "projects"."archive_notes" IS NULL AND "projects"."archived_from_stage" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("projects"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."archive_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."archive_revisit" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."archive_starred" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."archived_from_stage" IS NOT NULL)
      )
